verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's homepage says it 'moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible' and lets you 'screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently' with automation. Its docs describe an automatic audit trail of all work, which loosely implies agent-handled dispositions with a recorded basis. These are thin marketing claims with no documentation of an in-product agent reviewing screening matches or of how its rationale is recorded. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI agent for screening-match review, explicit per-decision rationale capture by the agent, hands-on or independent corroboration.
